description: Hand-curated seed whitelist of well-known shopping domains (Swiss-first). Positive trust signal for merchant scoring; complements OpenPhish/URLhaus negative lists and GLEIF/Zefix identity data.
license: Factual list of publicly known shopping domains, hand-curated; no third-party dataset ingested. No license constraints.

columns.confidence: high = major established retailer/platform; medium = legit platform with variable seller quality (e.g. marketplaces with 3P sellers)

usage_notes: Whitelist = positive evidence, never overriding: keep combining with blocklists, domain age, registry identity per canonical schema (missing info is not negative evidence).
Marketplace domains (amazon.*, ebay.*, ricardo.ch, aliexpress.com) vouch for the platform, NOT individual third-party sellers.
Matching must use domain_normalized (eTLD+1); subdomains like www.digitec.ch resolve to digitec.ch.
Expansion path: Curlie shopping directory, Wikidata retail queries, Swiss Online Garantie / trustmark member lists, Tranco+category gate (see DATA_SOURCES.md 'Planned / queued').
